text: ok that is good one more thing is wasd panning
resolution: Loader iso pane is now a fully navigable editor camera. WASD/arrow pan + Q/E orbit + F recenter via a direct key-bus subscription, drag-rotate, wheel-zoom — all driving the JS-solved iso pose pushed to world_loader's external camera. Two fixes made pan finally work + smooth: (1) the pan loop needed a setTimeout fallback when requestAnimationFrame isn't a host global (a bare rAF call silently never ran, so held keys were never read); (2) the loop pushed the camera across the host bridge every frame even idle ('lags like shit') — now it pushes ONLY when the pose moves (while panning), since the host pending-camera table re-applies the last pose each render. User confirmed: works, no longer lagging.
